spec.scope: Generic ATK buff (atkPct — scales each target's own ATK); not normal-attack-scoped, not caster-ATK-flat.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 (wall-clock seconds, literal 'for 10 sec'); re-applied each 20s interval → ~50% uptime steady-state.
spec.triggerIdentity: interval sec:20, first fire at t=20s (frame 1200) per the interval convention (first at t=sec, not t=0).
spec.targetSet: alliesTopAtk count:3, byFinalAtk:true — kit literally says 'highest final ATK', which per the A3 rule mandates live effectiveAtk ranking, not staticAtk. Self is in the candidate pool (no 'except self' clause); milk is an Attacker (top static tier) so she plausibly self-buffs.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Static-ATK ranking (byFinalAtk omitted — the plain-'highest ATK' default wrongly applied to a 'final ATK' line), and/or first fire at t=0 instead of t=20.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Filter buffApply events stat==='atkPct' && value===31.83: first application frame is 1200 (not 0), exactly 3 target events per activation, expiresFrame===applyFrame+600; in a comp where a live buff lifts a lower-static unit into the top 3 at an apply tick, the targetIdx set matches effectiveAtk ranking (red under static ranking).
spec.inertness: Must NOT apply to more than 3 units, must NOT be active during t=0–20s, and must NOT persist past 10s per application (no permanent uptime).

spec.kitLine: start of battle: Burst CD ▼ 20 sec cont.
spec.scope: Burst-cooldown modifier, self only — not a stat buff, not team CDR.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = permanent: EVERY burst cooldown cycle is 20s shorter (40s base → effective 20s CD), not a one-shot head-start.
spec.triggerIdentity: Battle-start/passive application; the load-bearing semantics are that the reduction applies to every cycle (burstCdr WITHOUT oncePerBattle, or an equivalent permanent CD modifier).
spec.targetSet: self only ('Affects self') — must NOT reduce teammates' burst cooldowns.
spec.nearestWrongModel: oncePerBattle:true — a single 20s reduction that accelerates only her FIRST burst, leaving subsequent cycles at 40s. Second nearest: applying the CDR to all allies.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In a comp where milk actually casts B1 each rotation, collect her burstCast frames: gaps between consecutive milk burstCast events are consistent with a ~20s CD (she casts on ~every FB rotation, ≥2× the cast count of a 40s-CD baseline over 180s). Red under oncePerBattle (first gap short, later gaps ~40s). Also assert liter's burst CD in the same comp is unchanged vs a milk-block-removed patch (self-only).
spec.inertness: Teammates' burst cooldowns must NOT move from this line; FB count of the comp must not change via any channel other than milk's own cast availability.

spec.scope: Generic critDamagePct — applies to all crit damage (weapon, riders that crit), not crit-rate, not normal-attack-scoped.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' while HP-gated; at scope lock the boss deals no damage so >80% HP always holds → permanent passive (documented simplification, not a drop).
spec.triggerIdentity: passive (the HP condition is scope-trivially always true; no activation event to key).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropping the line because the HP gate 'isn't modeled' (v1 has no HP pool), or encoding critRatePct instead of critDamagePct.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply events stat==='critDamagePct' && value===11.13 exist at frame 0 for all 5 units with no expiry (no expiresFrame lapse); red if absent (dropped-gate misread) or if stat==='critRatePct'.
spec.inertness: Crit RATE must not move; the buff must not toggle off at any point in the 180s fight.

spec.scope: Instant burst-cooldown reduction event (no duration, no stat buff).
spec.durationSemantics: Instantaneous CDR per proc; repeating — fires on EVERY 10th full-charge attack, not once per battle.
spec.triggerIdentity: Full-charge counter (chargeCounter count:10, single phase) — counts only milk's OWN full-charge shots. NOT hitCount (which counts rounds regardless of charge state — diverges whenever she fires uncharged, e.g. inside FB windows or under charge-speed effects) and NOT interval.
spec.targetSet: allies — ALL allies' burst cooldowns, including her own ('Affects all allies').
spec.nearestWrongModel: Self-only CDR (missing that a B1 support hands the CDR to the whole team), or hitCount:10 (round-count trigger inflating proc rate if any non-full-charge shots fire), or one-time-only.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A/B via withPatchedOverride('milk', strip this block): with the block live, teammates' (liter/crown/carry) burstCast frames come EARLIER and/or the comp's fullBurstStart count over 180s rises vs the stripped baseline — red under self-only (teammate cast frames identical). Proc cadence check: with ammo 6 / 60-frame charge / 141-frame reload, count milk's full-charge shots; the CDR event count equals floor(shots/10), repeating across the whole fight.
spec.inertness: Must NOT proc off teammates' charges or milk's burst cast; zero procs before her 10th full-charge shot.

spec.kitLine: Deals 367.34% final ATK as Burst dmg
spec.scope: One instant hit, burst bucket, 367.34% of caster final ATK, single enemy (highest final DEF — trivial on the partless single boss).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant on cast; snapshots buffs at cast time.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (her OWN Burst I cast) — never fullBurstEnter; per the measured timing rule, burst-cast damage lands BEFORE the FB window opens, so it is FB-exempt.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Applying the +50% Full-Burst major (and/or FB-entry auras) to the burst hit — keying it at/inside the FB window instead of pre-FB cast timing.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The damage event for this hit has bucket 'burst', mult 367.34, srcSlot 'burst', and fbMajorApplied===false / inFullBurst===false on every occurrence — red under the FB-credited misread. With her ~20s effective CD, the hit recurs on each rotation she casts (assert count > 1 over 180s).
spec.inertness: Must NOT receive the +30% range bonus rules applicable to weapon shots beyond its own path defaults, and must NOT appear when milk never casts (e.g. seated as a lone/never-selected burster).

spec.kitLine: Recovers 16.16% of atk dmg as HP over 10s
spec.scope: Heal-over-time to all allies; no HP amount modeled at scope (immortal units) — the modeled substance is the recovery EVENTS it emits (tandem channel).
spec.durationSemantics: 'over 10 sec' → heal with ticks:10, intervalSec:1 (repeated recovery events across the window), NOT a single instant event.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — fires only on rotations milk herself bursts.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipping the line as 'defensive, no damage' — the taxonomy's tandem trap: this heal drives any teammate's 'when recovery takes effect' consumer (crown is IN the control fixture). Second nearest: ticks:1 (one instant recovery event), which starves a recovery-triggered consumer's uptime across the 10s window.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: After each milk burstCast frame, each ally receives ~10 recovery-typed events spaced ~1s apart across the following 10s (observable via crown's recovery-trigger buffApply events re-firing throughout the window in controlComp-style comps) — red under both the skip and the single-tick misreads.
spec.inertness: Milk's own damage total must not change from this line in a comp with no recovery consumer; no recovery events outside the 10s post-cast window.

spec.scope: Received-healing amplifier — no HP pool and no StatKey exists for it; offensively inert at scope (recovery TRIGGERS fire on the event, not the amount).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Force-fitting it into an existing stat (e.g. a generic damage or heal-magnitude buff) instead of recording it verbatim in `unmodeled`.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No buffApply event exists attributing any stat to this line; the verbatim text appears in the override's unmodeled.burst array.

burst: (magnitude only) Recovers 16.16% of attack damage as HP — the recovery EVENTS are modeled via heal ticks; the HP amount is not (no HP pool at scope).
